name: Asterios
source:
Asterios tells the story of Hypildi, a human born without Astros.
An Astros is a power that almost the entire population possesses. 
Oppressed for his difference, his peers take him to the brink of death. An unknown hand full of hope reaches out to him. 
Will he seizes it and protect what is dear to him ?

[From [url=https://asteriosproject.itch.io/asterios]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Asterios》讲述了Hypildi的故事，Hypildi是一个出生时没有Astros的人类。
太空人队是几乎所有人都拥有的力量。
他的同龄人因他的与众不同而受到压迫，将他推向死亡的边缘。一只充满希望的未知的手向他伸出。
他会抓住它并保护他所珍视的东西吗？

[来自[url=https://asteriosproject.itch.io/asterios]Itch.io[/url]]
